# Table fixtures

These fixtures are trimmed from page captures made on 2026-10-18. Absolute URLs in the HTML point to example.org. Relative paths remain. Scripts, tracking attributes, personal data and unrelated page content are omitted. Raw captures stay outside this repository.

| Fixture | Source and captured version | Licence and changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tables/wikipedia-tallest.html` | [Wikipedia, List of tallest buildings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tallest_buildings), revision [1376498189](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_tallest_buildings&oldid=1376498189), captured 2026-10-18. | Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution is available through the [page history](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_tallest_buildings&action=history). Two header rows and five building rows retain spans, footnotes and image structure. URLs are rewritten. |
| `tables/github-playwright.html` | [GitHub, microsoft/playwright](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright), main at `b335271cdc2b57cac2be8ad37c5dd283ac6b8938`, captured 2026-10-18. | Page structure only. Directory paths remain; commit messages and dates are replaced with neutral placeholders or empty cells. Authors, usernames, avatars and tracking attributes are omitted. No GitHub page-content licence is asserted. |

## Discussion layout

`tables/hn-item.html` retains the nested comment-table structure from [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/), captured 2026-10-18. Structure only, content replaced. Comments, usernames and times use neutral placeholders. Item identifiers and tracking attributes are omitted. Links and spacer images point to example.org.

## Essay layout

`tables/pg-essay.html` retains the nested tables, spacer images and `<br><br>` paragraph breaks from [paulgraham.com](https://paulgraham.com/greatwork.html), captured 2026-10-18. Structure only, content replaced. The essay text is replaced with neutral sentences. Links and images point to example.org.
